subject: CS361
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. For English, choices prioritized practical application and deep conceptual explanations from highly-viewed channels. For Arabic, selections from top channels like Elzero Web School and أكاديمية ترميز were made, navigating around many ineligible candidates due to language mismatches, low views, or focus on other programming languages. In several cases, the provided `audioLang` metadata was incorrect and was overridden based on channel and title context.
